headline: Asian Markets Pressured by Tech Stocks, Korea's Kospi Plunges 4.49%
summary: Asian equity markets weakened, driven by pressure from Wall Street and declines in technology shares. South Korea's Kospi index fell 4.49%.
why: Asian equity indexes track the region's largest listed companies, many of them chipmakers and electronics exporters, so tech sell-offs spread quickly across the region.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index fell 4.49% in the reported selloff in technology shares.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The article links the decline to pressure from Wall Street and falling technology stocks across Asian markets.
original_headline: Bursa Asia Tertekan Saham Teknologi, Kospi Korea Anjlok 4,49%
